title: Last 12 months runs from the 1st of the month eleven months back to today
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. Work out the expected window for the day you test: start = the 1st of the month eleven months before this month, end = today. Example, testing on 7 October 2026: November 1, 2025 to October 7, 2026, which is 341 days counting both ends (30+31+31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30 = 334 days for November to September, plus 7).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Set the Revenue pill to Last 12 Months, open it again and read the dates at the top of the calendar and the Range line at the bottom.
  3. Press Escape.
  4. Read the Sales by Customer pill's calendar the same way.
  5. Click the report icon beside Revenue and read the dates in the Sales report's Date control.
  6. Go back and do the same from Billing Efficiency (Service Advisor Analysis), Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization (each set to Last 12 Months first) and Sales by Customer.
  7. In each of those five reports, also pick Last 12 months directly from the Date control and read the dates.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every tile's Last 12 Months starts on the 1st of the month eleven months back and ends today, in the shop's own time (e.g. November 1, 2025 to October 7, 2026, Range: 341 days, when tested on 7 October 2026).
  • Every one of the five reports covers the same dates on Last 12 months, whether opened from the tile or picked in the report.
  • None of them starts on the same calendar day one year ago (e.g. not October 7, 2025).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9582 (Story 10, Report Drill-In); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 10. Context note on the Last 12 months window. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) board 03_Range_After (calendar header 'Oct 1, 2025 — Sep 28, 2026' and 'Range: 363 days' on Sep 28, 2026), used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R8: “"Last 12 months" covers the same window on every tile and in every report the dashboard links to: from the first day of the month eleven months before the current month, through today, in the workplace's timezone. Example: on October 5, 2026 it covers November 1, 2025 to October 5, 2026.”
  • S10-R8: “"Last 12 months" covers the same window on every tile and in every report the dashboard links to: from the first day of the month eleven months before the current month, through today, in the workplace's timezone. Example: on October 5, 2026 it covers November 1, 2025 to October 5, 2026.”
  • Context note (Story 10, the Last 12 months window): “some other ShopView screens use a different "last 12 months", running from the same calendar day one year ago. The dashboard and the reports it links to do not use that window. A report that did would cover different dates from its tile and break S3-R1.”
